scope: Producer-only BullMQ queue module and standalone-worker outbox dispatcher; no API timer or consumer

implementation.architecture: VideoQueueModule owns configured producer and sanitized queue error listener; exports BullModule. VideoOutboxDispatcherModule imports queue+persistence and exports dispatcher for future standalone worker. AppModule/VideosModule untouched; API never imports queue/dispatcher/processor.
implementation.lifecycle: Native self-scheduled timeout, single active dispatch promise, duplicate bootstrap guard, no overlapping explicit/timer dispatch. Shutdown clears timer, blocks further claims and awaits active dispatch. Direct dispatch propagates errors; only background timer/shutdown boundaries catch and log sanitized operational failure.
implementation.claims: Existing transactional claimDispatch uses DB clock, skip_locked, unique token and deadline; no repository/schema changes. Batch1 avoids expiring serially-waiting batch claims. markDispatched/releaseDispatch use existing live-token fencing; false outcome is observable failure, not success.
implementation.publish: Queue.add process-video into video-processing with exact payload{schemaVersion:1,videoId}, jobId video-<uuid>, attempts3, exponential2000ms backoff, retain completed/failed jobs for deduplication. Only after successful add mark dispatched_at and recheck deadline; completed_at never touched by dispatcher. Processing attempt budget unchanged.
implementation.failure: Failed publish or post-add DB failure reschedules/release through fenced repository and fixed last_error. Release failure propagates AggregateError preserving both failures and leaves lease recoverable. No new upload needed.
implementation.producer_readiness: Finite initial readiness wait precedes Queue.add; timed-out wait cannot enqueue deferred work after claim release. enableOfflineQueue:false, maxRetriesPerRequest1, connectTimeout2000 and commandTimeout2000. Default BullMQ ready initialization retained because skipWaitingForReady alone can reject INFO/init irrecoverably when starting offline; actual initial-outage/reconnect tested.
implementation.operational_provenance: Dispatch timing defaults are named implementation constants; plan specifies semantics but no dispatch interval/lease values. Separate from media processing60s lease/10s heartbeat. No throughput/capacity guarantee.
implementation.redis_recovery: Real TCP fault gate in test API container makes Redis unreachable to producer without mocking Queue/SDK or stopping other services. Both established-connection outage and construction while unreachable recover after restoring actual TCP connectivity; intent remains open/undispatched until confirmed add.
implementation.crash_window: Real Redis add followed by real SQL division-by-zero failures in mark and release simulates crash gap with existing job and uncommitted dispatch/live claim. Expiring lease and dispatching again yields same single logical job and eventual dispatch mark.
implementation.tests: 12unit cases cover publication ordering, failures, ownership, bounded readiness, nonoverlap and lifecycle shutdown.6integration cases cover exact job/options, deduplication, outage/recovery, crash window, ineligible intents and initial outage.2module integration cases verify real DI/config/export and producer-only queue/no workers.
